This '''species''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that existed in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[K'Armyn Viraxo]] was a member of this species.<ref name="Game" />

==Biology and appearance==
This [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] was distinguished by the large, fleshy [[Bone/Legends|horn]] protruding from their foreheads.<ref name="Image" />

==Society and culture==
[[K'Armyn Viraxo]], patriarch of the [[Viraxo]] family and head of [[Viraxo Industries]], was a member of this species.<ref name="Game" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species first appeared in the [[1999]] video game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''.<ref name="Game" />
